title: 2-layer DC coupon (front and back probed)

assumptions: 2-layer core 1.51 mm (not published by JLCPCB): via barrel length ±10 % until the board thickness is measured
finished outer copper 35 µm (JLCPCB's stackup value; its impedance table says 40.6 µm): the van der Pauw crosses measure it

drill convention: the drill file's via sizes are finished holes (the fabs' standard; FAB_NOTES asks for them as drawn), but pdnsim's barrel (either via model) reads the board's drill as the drilled outer-barrel diameter (A = π·t·(d − t), docs/PHYSICS.md §3). If the hole is finished as drawn, the real barrel resistance differs from prediction (a)'s by 0.30 mm -11.3 %, 0.50 mm -6.9 % (−2t/(d + t) at 18 µm); (a) via errors of that size are this convention, not the via model; (b) uses the microsection's wall and finished hole and is immune

ENIG on every mask-free pad (nickel 3–6 µm, IPC-4552): the board thickness is read with a micrometer contact ≤ 2.5 mm centred on each 3 × 3 mm thickness island (docs/CORRELATION.md §3), so the reading includes the finish of both faces (+6–12 µm, ≤ 0.8 % of the span; not subtracted); a flat 6.35–8 mm anvil would also rest on the mask-covered pour and the silkscreen around the island (+10–80 µm, 0.6–5 %) and is not a valid reading; the vias are tented, so no finish in the measured barrels

sources.value: '1oz copper = copper thickness of 35 µm' and 0.035 mm outer copper in every published stackup; the impedance-design table gives 'Outer Layer Finished Copper Thickness (1 oz) 1.6 mil' (40.6 µm): 35 µm is used, the crosses measure the real value

ENIG ordered (a surcharge: 'ENIG is no longer offered as a free surface finish option', news of 2026-07-30). OSP is not: the quote form says OSP is 'Not supported for castellated/press-fit holes, plated blind slots, or physical contact areas (e.g., gold fingers, keypads)', and every kit pad is a spring-probe contact area (DECISIONS D170)
'Nickel thickness: approximately 3-6 micrometers; JLCPCB offers gold thicknesses of 1 or 2 microinches'
'Vias are treated differently from pads … Vias don't have a specified tolerance whereas pad through-holes are +0.13/-0.08 mm'; tented vias 'no larger than 0.5 mm'

'Order Number is not available since May 2026. Please DO NOT add "JLCJLCJLCJLC"'; free serial number (prefix + incrementing number), a 2 × 10 mm solid silkscreen square for 'Number only' at a specified position
